acceptance_results.criterion: insufficient search reservation prevents the call
expired wall-clock deadline prevents the call

focused_runtime_tests.command: uv run --frozen pytest tests/test_budget_diagnostics.py tests/test_sqlite_runtime.py tests/test_worker_leases.py tests/test_durable_paper_discovery.py -q

execution_boundary.fixtures: deterministic transports, temporary SQLite, and local filesystem
execution_boundary.claim: W3.4 proves bounded offline budget and diagnostic mechanisms; it does not prove live cost control, real process-kill recovery, or live paper-discovery quality.
